winCondition: Village wins when all werewolves are eliminated; Werewolves win when they equal or outnumber the villagers. Neutral roles (e.g. Vampires) have their own goals that depend on the role cards in play.
notes: family: hidden-role-social. Official Bezier rulebook not fetched; only core win conditions confirmed via Wikipedia. Neutral/special role goals depend on the cards used and are not modelled.
